hook: TinyWifiDongle turns an ESP32-S3 or Raspberry Pi Pico W board
hookText: TinyWifiDongle turns an ESP32-S3 or Raspberry Pi Pico W board

beats.say: Phil Schatzmann's MIT-licensed Arduino library bridges a microcontroller's Wi-Fi to USB CDC-NCM, so Linux, macOS and Windows 11 see a network adapter without extra drivers.
The board forwards Ethernet frames at Layer 2 between USB and Wi-Fi, so the computer gets its own IP from the router via DHCP with no NAT.
The author notes occasional USB stalls on the ESP32-S3 after 100 to 200 MB and one unexplained Pico reboot, and Windows 10 needs an extra driver.
